name: study-sofa-reading
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, photorealistic-natural. Create ONE finished lifestyle photograph with the same fictional 27-year-old adult woman in the reference, using it as an identity reference ONLY. Preserve her recognizable face, gentle soft cheeks, eye shape, nose, lips and natural light fringe. Bangs must not cover the eyes. Natural ordinary adult proportions, normal neck and head size, no elongated fashion-model body, no tiny head, no artificial leg lengthening. Human and environment must be photographed as one coherent scene, with physically consistent perspective, light, contact and occlusion. Detailed but natural skin, lifelike hands, understated candid feeling, NOT a cutout pasted onto a backdrop, NOT doll-like, NOT glossy 3D. Vertical 1024x1536, no captions, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Compose for a desktop companion portrait: her face clear and fairly large, enough surrounding environment to understand the moment, a little breathing space above her head.
Scene: a calm lived-in Suzhou apartment reading room, warm late-afternoon daylight through a sheer curtain, a real comfortable cream linen sofa, small bookshelf and a leafy plant. She is comfortably seated into the sofa cushion, leaning lightly against the armrest, holding an open paperback naturally with both hands and looking down at a passage with a faint absorbed smile. Long dark hair with the same sparse soft fringe. Cream knit cardigan over a white tee, soft muted sage midi skirt. Her bent knees and calves sit naturally in front of the sofa; normal anatomy and believable weight on the cushion. A mug on a small side table. Frame from head to lower calves, sofa fills lower composition; relaxed reading is the main action, not posing at camera. The book has no readable title.
